notes: State required decimal places or significant figures explicitly.
Declare calculator permission on every question.
Use S$ in learner-facing Singapore-dollar contexts and ask for an answer in dollars when the numeric response has no unit field.
Make the task itself assess its declared primary outcome; do not allocate a direct simplest-form task to a neighbouring outcome merely because it uses the same topic vocabulary.
Avoid repeating a prior question's context, operation pattern and numerical structure, even when wording changes enough to pass the near-prompt detector.
Keep stage-one hints conceptual and stage-two hints to an intermediate setup; neither hint may state the final answer.
Verify every canonical answer by independently recomputing it and substituting it back into the original conditions.
Levels 4 and 5 must require the method selection, constraints, justification or sustained synthesis described by the shared difficulty rubric.
Treat these rules as provisional until founder and reviewer approval.
